entries.zh: 喜欢（做某事），以做某事为乐
entries.en: to take pleasure in doing something; to delight in doing
entries.notes: H 栏「只耍」与 M 栏 hêng choā（当作「興做」）不对应，义依 L 栏并参 M 音读。

entries.zh: 欢喜，喜形于色，心满意足
entries.en: to be glad; to be content and show a joyful face
to rejoice; to be joyful
to play; to amuse oneself; to go out for fun
to be at ease; to relax and rest
entries.notes: H 栏「慨悅」标疑（当作「快」），M 栏 cûa oa/cûay oàt 指向「快活」，L 为 descansar，取舒畅、歇息义。

entries.en: to ascend to heaven together; to rejoice in heaven
entries.notes: R 栏 goamar en la cielo 系西语旁注（gozar en el cielo），非官话对音，释义据此及 L 栏。

entries.zh: 欢欣踊跃，高兴得跳起来
entries.en: to leap with joy; to be elated
to frolic; to play mischievously
entries.notes: H 栏「頑」有疑，M 栏后半 ĩg iàc 难解，取「頑耍」嬉戏义。

entries.en: to be delighted; joyful
to make merry; to entertain oneself
to be merry; to feel comfortable and at ease
to make merry with a lion dance
entries.notes: L 栏 la procua 疑为衍误，H「打獅弄獅」与 M sāy/lāng 明指弄狮。

entries.en: to loaf about; idler; vagabond
entries.notes: H「蕩」与 L holgazán 相应，M、R 两栏多字污损（T99）难辨，仅存大意。

entries.en: idler; lazy fellow
entries.notes: H 栏首字标疑（驗/戇），M 栏音写残损，义依 L holgacan（holgazán）。

entries.zh: 享乐闲散之人；游手好闲者
entries.en: a merry idler; one given to ease and pleasure
entries.notes: 处 holgazán 条下，M loc lāng 与「樂人」相合，取耽于享乐、不事生产义。

entries.zh: 蹦跳游荡；闲不住的游荡者
entries.en: to jump about; a restless loiterer
entries.notes: H 栏末字标疑（範/汎），M thiàu huan 词义不确，据「跳」与 holgazán 推为蹦跳游荡。

entries.zh: 蛀米虫；喻坐吃闲饭的懒人
entries.en: rice weevil; (fig.) a parasite, idle dependent
entries.notes: H 栏末字标疑（蠹/蟲），「蛀米蠹」喻寄生闲食者，与 holgazán 相合。

entries.en: a poet; a man of letters
entries.notes: 处 holgazán 条下，或指吟风弄月的闲散文人；M Có queh 对音不确。

entries.en: to lean about here and there; to idle

entries.zh: 问候语：「愿汝好」（愿你安好）
entries.en: a greeting: 'may you be well'
entries.notes: H 栏首字「頭」与 M guān（当作「願」）不合，L 栏为书信套语且残，义据 M 推定为问候。
